name: Tiny Bend
note: The one city config. render/camera.js, render/grid.js and render/dem.js read it; tests/test_city.mjs checks they agree. See PLAN.md.

city.label: Bend, widened west for Phil's trails (Colin, 2026-11-27)

gap.fill: relief chart drawn in code from the DEM, summer and winter tints, with Fly to Bachelor (Colin, 2026-11-27)

ground.source: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 (ESA, free with credit). Heights are above the EGM2008 geoid; add geoidOffset for heights above the WGS84 ellipsoid, which the render uses.
ground.geoidOffsetSource: Measured 2026-11-28: median of render height (probe depth pass, ellipsoid) minus DEM height (geoid), 16,384 points in four town and forest probe shots. Per shot medians -18.2 to -20.8 m. See writeup/journal.md, 2026-11-28.

winter.source: second LoRA repainting the finished summer map, pixel-aligned (Colin, 2026-11-27)

accounts.modalSecretsNote: Modal secrets are shared across the workspace: r2 is Tiny Perth's. Bend's R2 token is r2-tinybend.
